paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between prompt depth and accuracy. The x-axis represents prompt depth, labeled as "Prompt Depth (J)", with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 11, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents accuracy, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 74 to 81, and tick labels at intervals of 1. There are two lines in the plot: one is orange and dashed, representing "mmsd", and the other is blue and solid, representing "mmsd2". The orange line starts at approximately 80% accuracy at prompt depth 1 and increases to around 82% at prompt depth 9, before decreasing to about 80% at prompt depth 11. The blue line starts at approximately 76% accuracy at prompt depth 1, decreases to around 74% at prompt depth 3, then increases to about 77% at prompt depth 7, before decreasing to around 76% at prompt depth 11.
